youtube.title: Julius Caesar got kidnapped and told pirates to charge MORE 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Pirates kidnapped Julius Caesar and asked for 20 talents. 🏴‍☠️

Caesar was offended. He told them he was worth at least 50.

Pirates or Caesar: who got played? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch: around 75 BC Cilician pirates captured young Caesar and demanded 20 talents; he laughed, told them to ask for 50, read them his poems during his 38 days as a hostage, and promised to come back for them. He did.

#juliuscaesar #caesar #ancientrome #romanhistory #pirates #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
